name: skill-release
examples_zh: 把 douyin-downloader 发布到三个平台
只更新 skillhub，GitHub 先不动
发到 open.workbuddy 报目录层级超限，帮我定位
检查一下这个技能满不满足上架条件
发个新版本，顺便把版本号升一位
扫一遍我的 GitHub 账号，看有没有提交带着真名
examples_en: Release douyin-downloader to all three platforms
Only update SkillHub, leave GitHub alone for now
open.workbuddy rejected my skill for directory depth, help me locate it
Check whether this skill meets the publishing requirements
Cut a new release and bump the version
Audit my GitHub account for commits that leak my real name
description_zh: 把技能一次分发到 GitHub / SkillHub / open.workbuddy，平台字段自动投影到临时副本，两条真实被拒过的平台规则前置成本地断言，默认演练。
description_en: Release a skill to GitHub / SkillHub / open.workbuddy in one command, with platform metadata projected into a staging copy and the two rules platforms actually rejected turned into local assertions.
